'''''The Treachery of Images''''' ({{langx|fr|'''La Trahison des images'''|link=no}}) is a 1929 painting by Belgian [[surrealist]] painter [[René Magritte]]. It is also known as '''''This Is Not a Pipe''''',<ref  name="Foucault"/> '''''Ceci n'est pas une pipe'''''<ref  name="Foucault">{{cite book|last=Foucault|first=Michel|title=This is Not a Pipe|others=James Harkness (editor, translator), René Magritte (illustrator)|location=Berkeley|publisher=University of California Press|date=2008|edition=2|isbn=9780520236943|url=https://monoskop.org/images/9/99/Foucault_Michel_This_Is_Not_a_Pipe.pdf|archive-date=2017-12-19|access-date=2017-07-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171219231053/https://monoskop.org/images/9/99/Foucault_Michel_This_Is_Not_a_Pipe.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref> and '''''The Wind and the Song'''''.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1080/00043249.1985.10792322|jstor=776809|last=Bowman|first=Russell|title=Words and Images: A Persistent Paradox|journal=Art Journal|year=2014|volume=45|issue=4|pages=335–343}}</ref> It is on display at the [[Los Angeles County Museum of Art]].<ref name="lacma1"/>

The painting shows an image of a [[tobacco pipe]]. Below it, Magritte painted, "{{lang|fr|Ceci n'est pas une pipe}}" ({{IPA|fr|sə.si ne paz‿yn pip|pron}}, French for "This is not a pipe".)
{{Blockquote|text = The famous pipe. How people reproached me for it!  And yet, could you stuff my pipe?  No, it's just a representation, is it not? So if I had written on my picture "This is a pipe", I'd have been lying!
|author = René Magritte<ref name="Torczyner1">{{cite book|last=Torczyner|first=Harry|title=Magritte: Ideas and Images|year=1977|page=71|publisher=H. N. Abrams |isbn=9780810913004}}</ref>}}

The theme of pipes with the text "Ceci n'est pas une pipe" is extended in ''Les Mots et Les Images'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ideophone.org/magritte-on-words-and-images/|title=René Magritte - Les mots et les images|website=The Ideophone|date=13 July 2013|access-date=25 July 2017|archive-date=13 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171113071023/http://ideophone.org/magritte-on-words-and-images/|url-status=live}}</ref> ''La Clé des Songes'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.artnet.com/artists/ren%C3%A9-magritte/la-cl%C3%A9-des-songes-a-2t31F4pOvilbRkGeHVsjOw2|title=René Magritte – La Clé des Songes.|website=Artnet|access-date=25 July 2017|archive-date=24 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171224123018/http://www.artnet.com/artists/ren%C3%A9-magritte/la-cl%C3%A9-des-songes-a-2t31F4pOvilbRkGeHVsjOw2|url-status=live}}</ref> ''Ceci n'est pas une pipe (L'air et la chanson)'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.artnet.com/artists/ren%C3%A9-magritte/ceci-nest-pas-une-pipe-lair-et-le-chanson-iLdZ-PjAr0bdok6iheXnLA2|title=René Magritte – Ceci n'est pas une pipe (L'air et le chanson)|website=Artnet|access-date=25 July 2017|archive-date=1 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180301061012/http://www.artnet.com/artists/ren%C3%A9-magritte/ceci-nest-pas-une-pipe-lair-et-le-chanson-iLdZ-PjAr0bdok6iheXnLA2|url-status=live}}</ref> ''The Tune and Also the Words'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.artic.edu/aic/collections/artwork/119129|title=René Magritte - L'air et le chanson|website=Art Institute Chicago|year=1964|access-date=25 July 2017|archive-date=1 August 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170801075950/http://www.artic.edu/aic/collections/artwork/119129|url-status=live}}</ref> ''Ceci n'est pas une pomme'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://muides2.free.fr/HIDA/Magritte/trahisondesimages.pdf|title=René Magritte – Ceci n'est pas une pomme|access-date=25 July 2017|archive-date=6 November 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151106153354/http://muides2.free.fr/HIDA/Magritte/trahisondesimages.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref> and ''Les Deux Mystères''.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.abcgallery.com/M/magritte/magritte54.html |title=René Magritte – The Two Mysteries. |website=abcgallery.com |access-date=3 October 2010 |archive-date=6 April 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180406154230/http://www.abcgallery.com/m/magritte/magritte54.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

The painting is sometimes given as an example of [[meta message]]<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1075/sl.28.1.14hai|title=Review of "Languages within language: An evolutive approach" by Ivan Fonagy|journal=Studies in Language|volume=28|pages=246|year=2004|last1=Haiman|first1=John}}</ref> like [[Alfred Korzybski]]'s "The word is not the thing" and "[[Map–territory relation|The map is not the territory]]", as well as [[Denis Diderot]]'s ''[[This is not a story]]''.

On December 15, 1929, [[Paul Éluard]] and [[André Breton]] published an essay about poetry in ''[[La Révolution surréaliste]]'' (The Surrealist Revolution) as a reaction to the publication by poet [[Paul Valéry]] "Notes sur la poésie" in ''[[Les Nouvelles littéraires]]'' of September 28, 1929. When Valéry wrote "Poetry is a survival", Breton and Éluard made fun of it and wrote "Poetry is a pipe", as a reference to Magritte's painting.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://inventin.lautre.net/livres/La-revolution-surrealiste-12.pdf|title=La revolution surrealiste|access-date=2019-02-13|archive-date=2021-03-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210308225152/https://inventin.lautre.net/livres/La-revolution-surrealiste-12.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Zanchetti |first=Giorgio |title=Esploratori di parole, in La parola nell'arte |chapter=Esploratori di parole |publisher=Skira |year=2007 |isbn=978-88-613-0460-4 |location=Milan |pages=26 |language=it |doi=10.5281/zenodo.3597936}}</ref>

In the same edition of ''La Révolution surréaliste'', Magritte published "''Les mots et les images''" (his founding text which illustrated where words play with images), his answer to the survey on love, and ''Je ne vois pas la [femme] cachée dans la forêt'', a painting tableau surrounded by photos of sixteen surrealists with their eyes closed, including Magritte himself.

The away kit of the [[Belgium national football team|Belgian National Team]] for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup|2026 World Cup]] was described by the [[Royal Belgian Football Association|Royal Belgian FA]] as “a tribute to René Magritte and Belgian Surrealism,” featuring a surrealist theme. A reference to The Treachery of Images is made through the inscription “Ceci n'est pas un maillot” (“This is not a jersey”) printed behind the collar.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://shop.rbfa.be/en/belgium-national-team-adidas-away-authentic-shirt-2026/p-134481601128274852+z-93-702195220|title=Belgium National Team adidas Away Authentic Shirt 2026}}</ref>
